queries: 2022 task oriented dialogue semantic parsing natural language generation meanings evaluation

sources_considered.why: A contemporary system explicitly evaluates both text-to-meaning-representation parsing and generation in the reverse direction.
Relevant to semantic parsing and generalization, but does not establish both directions of general language competence.
The later conference record does not by itself establish that the reported system and results existed by July 20.

evidence_items.explanation: The system performs both directions using Abstract Meaning Representation graphs. This challenges a literal claim that machines could perform no sentence-to-meaning or meaning-to-sentence mapping, but does not establish general humanlike language acquisition.

unresolved_gaps: The evidence establishes restricted semantic mappings, not the general competence implied by the comparison with children.
The search found no comprehensive basis for the universal assertion that no existing machine possessed the stated competence.
No supplied criterion determines when successful semantic mappings count as acquiring language.
